items.title: Truist Financial (TFC) Leadership Changes Leave Valuation Questions Front And Center
items.summary: Truist Financial (TFC) just reshuffled key regional leadership, naming Phillip Avant to oversee the Virginias and appointing Stephen Kersey as Alabama regional president, moves that put fresh eyes on the bank’s commercial footprint. For context, Truist Financial shares closed at US$47.74, with the stock down 5% over the past week and lower by about 5% over the last three months.
